text.text: In the original, a Seared Duct selects one fluid with a filled bucket or Copper Can in its filter slot. That filter and its fluid display are not implemented in this port.

The block is registered, but its existing faucet path uses the same bottom fluid selected in the controller as a Drain. It does not filter fluids. Use a Seared Drain for the supported fluid-transfer instructions on the previous page.
This is an explanation of a missing feature, not a working filter guide. Live play, save/reload and LAN remain unverified.
